sofia.name: Sofia
sofia.label: the young woman with wavy dark-brown hair and a mustard cardigan
sofia.appearance: Sofia, a 28-year-old Spanish woman: light olive skin, brown eyes, shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair worn loose, slim average build, small gold hoop earrings, no glasses.
sofia.outfit: Mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over a plain white T-shirt, dark-blue jeans, white sneakers.

noor.name: Noor
noor.label: the young woman with a blonde ponytail and round glasses
noor.appearance: Noor, a 25-year-old Dutch woman: fair skin with light freckles, blue eyes, straight light-blonde hair in a high ponytail, round tortoiseshell glasses, tall and slender.
noor.outfit: Long-sleeved Breton top with white and sage-green horizontal stripes, black jeans, dark-green canvas sneakers.

daan.name: Daan
daan.label: the tall man with short light-brown hair and a short beard
daan.appearance: Daan, a 32-year-old Dutch man: light skin, short neatly combed light-brown hair, short trimmed beard, tall and lean.
daan.outfit: Navy-blue rain jacket over a grey hoodie, dark chinos, brown leather shoes; often carries a black bike helmet.

henk.name: Henk
henk.label: the older man with white hair, a moustache and a terracotta sweater
henk.appearance: Henk, a 67-year-old Dutch man: ruddy light skin, short white hair, bushy white moustache, round friendly face, sturdy build.
henk.outfit: Terracotta-red knitted sweater, beige trousers, brown shoes.

ingrid.name: Ingrid
ingrid.label: the woman with a grey bob and a navy blazer
ingrid.appearance: Ingrid, a 54-year-old Dutch woman: light skin, sleek chin-length grey bob, slim, upright posture.
ingrid.outfit: Navy-blue blazer over a light-blue blouse, grey trousers, black flat shoes; carries a leather folder.

ahmed.name: Ahmed
ahmed.label: the man with short black hair, a black beard and a dark-green work jacket
ahmed.appearance: Ahmed, a 40-year-old Dutch-Moroccan man: medium-brown skin, short black hair, neat black beard, friendly smile, medium build.
ahmed.outfit: Dark-green work jacket with rolled-up sleeves over a grey T-shirt, dark work trousers, black boots.

fleur.name: Fleur
fleur.label: the sporty young woman with a sun-bleached messy bun and a coral sports jacket
fleur.appearance: Fleur, a 27-year-old Dutch woman: sun-tanned light skin with freckles, blue eyes, sun-bleached dark-blonde hair in a messy bun, no glasses, athletic build, big open smile.
fleur.outfit: Coral-pink zip-up sports jacket over a white T-shirt, black leggings, grey running shoes.

marieke.name: Marieke
marieke.label: the woman with curly auburn hair, red glasses and a plum dress
marieke.appearance: Marieke, a 52-year-old Dutch woman: light skin, shoulder-length curly auburn hair with a few grey strands, rectangular dark-red glasses, warm patient smile, average build.
marieke.outfit: Long plum-purple knitted dress over dark tights, a mustard-and-sage patterned scarf, brown ankle boots.

piotr.name: Piotr
piotr.label: the stocky man with a sandy-blond buzz cut and a burgundy padded jacket
piotr.appearance: Piotr, a 34-year-old Polish man: light skin with rosy cheeks, very short sandy-blond buzz cut, clean-shaven, broad shoulders, stocky build, shy friendly smile.
piotr.outfit: Burgundy padded jacket over a dark-blue T-shirt, light-blue jeans, grey sneakers.

karin.name: Karin
karin.label: the woman with short cropped dark hair, black glasses and a charcoal turtleneck
karin.appearance: Karin, a 48-year-old Dutch woman: light skin, short cropped dark-brown hair with a silver streak at the front, black rectangular glasses, small silver stud earrings, calm direct expression, slim build.
karin.outfit: Charcoal-grey knitted turtleneck jumper, black trousers, white leather sneakers.
